description: Target emergency fund for a chosen number of months of essential expenses, the remaining gap, percent funded, and months to fill it at a monthly savings rate. Use when the user asks how big an emergency fund should be, or how close they are to the target. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive emergency fund calculator.

months_of_coverage.description: Months of expenses to cover, typically 3, 6, 9, or 12; default 6.
